![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbVpnIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b3db9977ad83b330af728a35b1e7430eee66bb92/Logo%20de%20Moda%20con%20Iniciales%20Caligr%C3%A1fico%20Elegante%20Rosa%20y%20Negro.png)

¡La ciudad de Valparaíso se prepara para vivir una experiencia única llena de velocidad, destreza y emoción con el segundo campeonato del año dedicado al fascinante mundo del cubo Rubik! El "Valparaíso Summer Open 2024" promete ser un evento inolvidable para los amantes del cubo y para aquellos que desean sumergirse en la magia de los rompecabezas con sus diferentes categorías: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 y Pyraminx!

The city of Valparaíso is gearing up to host a unique experience filled with speed, skill, and excitement in the second championship of the year dedicated to the fascinating world of the Rubik's Cube! The "Valparaíso Summer Open 2024" promises to be an unforgettable event for cube enthusiasts and those who wish to immerse themselves in the magic of puzzles with their different categories: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, and Pyraminx!

venue.name: Reliance Mall, Kalarcode, Eravukadu, Alappuzha, Kerala - 688003, India

items.information:
**Important Reminders for Participants**

Please ensure you arrive at the venue at least 15 minutes prior to your event start time to guarantee your participation. Late arrivals will not be permitted.

If you are participating in a WCA competition for the first time or are unfamiliar with the competition rules, we highly recommend attending the tutorial session. This session will provide you with essential information and guidance.

For first-time WCA competitors, kindly remember to bring your ID card along. This will help facilitate the registration process and ensure a smooth experience.

Thank you for your cooperation, and we wish you a fantastic competition!

Team mcubes!

items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TritonTricubealon2024#33092-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
